title: DevOps & Infrastructure
description: Infrastructure challenges: containerization, CI/CD, monitoring, configuration management

problems.title: Dockerfile Optimization
problems.description: Optimize a Dockerfile to reduce image size and build time using multi-stage builds and layer caching.
problems.original_dockerfile:
FROM python:3.11
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
RUN python -m pytest
RUN pip install gunicorn
CMD ["gunicorn", "app:app"]
requirements: Remove test dependencies from production image
Use slim or alpine base image

problems.title: CI/CD Pipeline Design
problems.description: Design a GitHub Actions workflow for a Python web application with testing, security scanning, and deployment.
requirements: Run tests on PR and push to main
Deploy to staging on merge to main

problems.title: Kubernetes Deployment Manifest
problems.description: Create Kubernetes manifests for a web application with proper resource limits, health checks, and autoscaling.

problems.title: Monitoring and Alerting Setup
problems.description: Design a monitoring stack with Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, and alerting rules.
requirements: Custom application metrics (request latency, error rate)
Alert rules: high error rate, high latency, pod restarts

problems.title: Infrastructure as Code
problems.description: Write Terraform configuration to provision a scalable web application infrastructure on AWS.
